title: Postdoctoral researchers and Junior group leaders  - Turku (Kaupunki), Varsinais-Suomi (FI) job with University of Turku | 12866312
gist: Job listing: the University of Turku's TCSMT, a STEM-only Institute for Advanced Study, is hiring four junior group leaders (~63,500 EUR/yr) and four postdocs (~47,000 EUR/yr) on three-year contracts, deadline January 15, 2027. Thin recruitment content with little market signal.

insights.claim: The University of Turku's Turku Collegium for Science, Medicine and Technology (TCSMT) is recruiting four junior group leaders and four postdoctoral researchers, all funded for three years, with application deadline January 15, 2027.
